text: マサキさんを　おかり　しますね　せっかく　いらしたのに　なにも　できなくて　ごめんなさい

structure.jp: マサキさんを　おかり　しますね
せっかく　いらしたのに
structure.en: even though you came all this way

structure.jp: なにも　できなくて
structure.en: I can't do anything, and so

patterns.name: お〜する
patterns.explanation: お + verb stem + する is a humble, polite way to say you do something for or to the listener. おかりします = 'I'll (humbly) borrow'.

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', with a feeling of regret that things did not turn out as they should. いらした is a respectful word for 'came'. せっかく いらしたのに = 'even though you took the trouble to come'.

patterns.name: 〜て (reason)
patterns.span: できなくて　ごめんなさい
patterns.explanation: The て-form before an apology gives what you are sorry for. なにも できなくて ごめんなさい = 'sorry that I can't do anything'.
